summary: Phu Quoc is a flight and a west-coast sunset. Ha Long is a boat among the karst. Cat Ba is a night on the island itself.
body: Phu Quoc sits in the Gulf of Thailand. The west coast is the sunset beaches and the resorts. The north has quieter sand. Long Beach is the sand in front of the main strip. Sao Beach is the paler curve in the southeast, a day visit from Long Beach.

Ha Long is a drowned karst landscape east of Hanoi. Most people see it from a day boat or an overnight cruise. Cat Ba is the large island at the western edge of Ha Long and Lan Ha, for a night on land, a hike, and the bay. The Cham Islands are the morning boat from Cửa Đại, with a village night in Bai Lang if you stay. The visit fee is 70,000 VND a person from 10 June 2026, and the boat is separate. Nha Trang’s islands are a boat trip from the city sand.
